chapter.verse: Tua ciangin ciangkhut tawh a kibang, a sau tehna ciangtawn khat kei hong kipia a, “Dingto inla Pasian' biakinnpi leh biakpiaktau leh tua taka Pasian a bia mite va teh in.
Ahih hangin biakinnpi pualam inntual ahihleh teh kei inla tua mun hal in. A hang pen khualmite' tungah tua mun a kipia hi a, amaute in kha sawmli-le-nih sung khuapi siangtho tuancil ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka teci nihte' tungah phalna ka pia ding a, amaute in puanham silhin ni 1,260 sung kamsang ding uh hi,” hong kici hi.
Tuate pen leitung a uk Topa' mai-a a ding olive kung nih leh meivaktau nih ahi uh hi.
Amaute a suksiat sawm a om ciangin a kam panun meikuang phulkhia a, a galte uh mei in kangtum hi. Amaute a suksiat sawm khatpeuh a om leh tu-a bangin thahna thuak ding hi.
Amaute in a kamsan sung teng uh guah a zuk loh nadingin vantung khak theihna thu nei uh a, ut hunhunin tuite sisan suahsak theihna thu leh gimpina a namkim tawh leitung gawt theihna thu nei uh hi.
Teci panna a man uh ciangin leihawmpi sungpana hong kahto sapia in amaute galin sim ding a, galzo-in amaute that ding hi.
Tua misiluangte, a Topa uh a kikhailupna mun, Sodom leh Egypt ci-in etsakna lim tawh a kilo, khuapi lian sung lampi tungah kikoih ding hi.
Tualmite, minamte, kampaute leh khualmite kimkhat in ni thum-le-lang sung a misiluangte uh en ding uh a, han ah a kivui ding phal lo ding uh hi.
Hih kamsang nihte in leitunga om mite nakpi gawt ngei khin uh ahih manin amau' sihna hangin leitunga om mite lungdamin gualnuam ding uh a, khatekhat khuttawi vanlenate kipia ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua ni thum-le-lang khit ciangin tua mite' sungah Pasian' kiangpan nuntakna hu lut a, amaute a khe tung uhah dingto uh ahih manin a mute khempeuh' tungah thakhatin launa lianpi tung hi.
Tua ciangin vantung pan, “Hih takah hong paito un!” cihna awging lianpi khat za uh ahih manin a galte uh' etcik laitak mahin amaute vantung ah meiilom khat tawh kahto uh hi.
Tua hunlenai lianin nakpi-in zinling a, khuapi seh sawm-ah-khat cim hi. Zinlinna hangin mimal tulsagih si-in a omlai teng lau mahmah uh a, vantung Pasian a minpha phat uh hi.
Dahhuai thu a nihna a bei hita a, en un, a thumna hong tung ding hi pah hi.

Tua ciangin vanmi sagihna in a pengkul a tum ciangin vantung ah awging lianpite om a, “Leitung kumpigam pen i Topa leh ama' Khris' kumpigam suak khinta hi. Amah in a tawntung a tawntungin uk ding hi,” ci hi.
Pasian' mai-a amau' kumpi-tokhom tung tek-a tu makai sawmnih-le-lite in leilak ah a maitang uh matsukin Pasian bia uh a,
hih bangin ci uh hi: “Tu laitaka om, a om ngeisa, Vanglian Topa Pasian' tungah lungdam kong ko uh hi. A hang pen na thahatna lianpi zangkhia-in uk na kipan khinzo hi.

Minamte lungso uh a, ahih hangin nangma' hehna hong tungin misite thukhenna na piak ding hun ahi zongin, na silate, kamsangte, mi siangthote leh nangma' min a kihta mite a neu a lian' tungah pahtakman a kipiak ding hun ahi zongin, leitung a susiate a kisuksiat ding hun ahi zongin hong tung khin hi.”
Tua ciangin vantunga om Pasian' biakinnpi kihong a, ama' biakinnpi sungah ama' thuciamna singkuang kilang hi. Khuaphia, vanging, kekkia leh zinling om a, gial golpi zong kia hi.
